How a transaction becomes a QuickBooks journal
Nothing posts until final approval, so QuickBooks never holds an unapproved commitment
STEP 1
Final approval fires
The tracker reaches stage 5 and the transaction is locked from further edits.
STEP 2
Lines are translated
Each expense category maps to an account; the department maps to a class; the donor code maps to a location.
STEP 3
Journal is posted
A single journal entry carries the WEWE reference in its memo so both systems reconcile by reference.
STEP 4
Failures queue, never vanish
Anything QuickBooks rejects lands in the exception queue with the reason, and retries every four hours.

Article 4 — Allowable costs and rates
4.1 The Recipient shall charge only costs that are reasonable, allocable and allowable under the terms of this agreement and applicable regulations. Costs incurred outside the period of performance are not allowable.
4.2 Travel and subsistence shall be charged at the Recipient’s published rates. Domestic per diem for band B locations, including Enugu, Kano and Port Harcourt, is set at ₦25,000.00 per night for officer grade with effect from 01/01/2026.
4.3 Any single procurement above ₦500,000.00 requires three written quotations retained on file. Where the lowest quotation is not selected, a written justification signed by the Procurement Officer and countersigned by Internal Audit shall be filed with the transaction.
4.4 Cash advances shall be retired within fourteen (14) days of the completion of the activity, supported by original receipts. Unretired advances beyond this period shall be recovered from the next salary payment.
